notes: Single main article, no supplementary file. record.json is_retracted is false and the PDF carries no retraction notice. Hydrogen uptake is measured on activated carbons and activated carbon fibers at 293 K up to 70 MPa (isotherms in mmol/g in Figure 1; wt% values in Figure 2). Table 1 gives BET areas for seven of eight samples (CF is listed as 0 m2/g, the others 1058-2575 m2/g). The paper says it extends earlier work to higher pressure (ref 26 went to 6 MPa) and does not state that all its uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. It is an original research article, not a review.
